whyItMatters: os.execute passes its argument to command execution in lua, so untrusted input reaching it becomes command injection.
actions: Replace os.execute with an argument-vector launcher instead of the shell, passing untrusted data as separate arguments, never interpolated into a command string.
If a shell is required, restrict the command to a fixed allowlist and validate every argument against it.
Re-run the scan and confirm no os.execute call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no os.execute reachable from untrusted input, and command tests with metacharacter input execute safely.
